# package keyring

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-knx/keyring"
```

Package keyring reads and writes KNX keyring files (.knxkeys, namespace [http://knx.org/xml/keyring/1](http://knx.org/xml/keyring/1)), the export of the secure keys and passwords of an ETS project: the backbone key of secure routing, the users and passwords of secure tunnelling, the group keys and senders of Data Secure, and the device keys.

The format follows the KNX keyring support article and xknx's reader (see docs/standards/SPECIFICATIONS.md, "KNX Secure sources"). Values are decrypted on load; the signature is verified first.

## Constants

```go
const Namespace = "http://knx.org/xml/keyring/1"
```

Namespace is the XML namespace of keyring files.

## Variables

```go
var ErrSignature = fmt.Errorf("%w: keyring: signature verification failed (wrong password or modified file)", knx.ErrSecurity)
```

ErrSignature reports a keyring whose signature does not match: a wrong password or a modified file.

### type Interface

```go
type Interface struct {
	Type              InterfaceType
	IndividualAddress knx.IndividualAddress
	// Host is the individual address of the device providing the
	// interface; HasHost reports whether the file gives one.
	Host    knx.IndividualAddress
	HasHost bool
	// UserID is the secure tunnelling user (0 when none).
	UserID uint8
	// Password is the user's password, Authentication the device
	// authentication password of the host.
	Password       string
	Authentication string
	// Groups are the secured groups the interface receives, each with
	// its allowed senders.
	Groups map[knx.GroupAddress][]knx.IndividualAddress
}
```

Interface is a tunnelling address (one user of a secure interface) or another interface.

#### func (Interface) Credentials

```go
func (i *Interface) Credentials() (secure.Credentials, error)
```

Credentials returns the secure tunnelling credentials of a tunnelling interface: its user and password, and the host's device authentication password when the keyring has it.

### type Keyring

```go
type Keyring struct {
	Project   string
	CreatedBy string
	// Created is the creation time as written in the file; it seeds the
	// encryption of the values.
	Created string

	// Backbone is the secure routing backbone, nil when absent.
	Backbone   *Backbone
	Interfaces []Interface
	// GroupKeys are the Data Secure keys of the group addresses.
	GroupKeys map[knx.GroupAddress]Key
	Devices   []Device
}
```

Keyring is a decrypted keyring.

#### func Load

```go
func Load(r io.Reader, password string) (*Keyring, error)
```

Load reads a keyring of at most 4 MiB; a longer input is rejected as knx.ErrMalformed without reading further.

#### func LoadFile

```go
func LoadFile(path, password string) (*Keyring, error)
```

LoadFile reads a keyring file of at most 4 MiB.

#### func Parse

```go
func Parse(b []byte, password string) (*Keyring, error)
```

Parse decodes and decrypts a keyring. Documents larger than 4 MiB, nested deeper than 64 levels or with more than 262144 elements are rejected as knx.ErrMalformed before the signature is checked.

#### func (Keyring) BackboneKey

```go
func (k *Keyring) BackboneKey() (secure.Key, time.Duration, bool)
```

BackboneKey returns the secure routing backbone key and latency.

#### func (Keyring) DataSecure

```go
func (k *Keyring) DataSecure(seq uint64) (*datasecure.Table, error)
```

DataSecure returns the Data Secure tables of the keyring: its group keys and senders; seq is the first sending sequence number (0: derived from the clock, see datasecure.NewTable).

#### func (Keyring) Device

```go
func (k *Keyring) Device(a knx.IndividualAddress) *Device
```

Device returns the device with the individual address, or nil.

#### func (Keyring) Encode

```go
func (k *Keyring) Encode(password string) ([]byte, error)
```

Encode writes the keyring as a .knxkeys document encrypted and signed with password. It is meant for test installations and tools; ETS remains the source of keyrings for real projects. An empty Created is set to the current time.

#### func (Keyring) Interface

```go
func (k *Keyring) Interface(a knx.IndividualAddress) *Interface
```

Interface returns the interface with the individual address, or nil.

#### func (Keyring) Senders

```go
func (k *Keyring) Senders() map[knx.IndividualAddress]uint64
```

Senders returns every Data Secure sender of the keyring with its last known sequence number: the senders listed by the interfaces (0), and the devices (their sequence numbers).

#### func (Keyring) Tunnels

```go
func (k *Keyring) Tunnels(host knx.IndividualAddress) []Interface
```

Tunnels returns the tunnelling interfaces of a host device.
